scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply pymhubdb --remote --env production -c ../../apps/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply pymeshub-staging --remote --env staging -c ../../apps/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:seed: bun run src/seed.ts && wrangler d1 execute pymhubdb --local -c ../../apps/api/wrangler.toml --file ./seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute pymhubdb --local -c ../../apps/api/wrangler.toml --file ./seed-credentials.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: bun run src/seed.ts && wrangler d1 execute pymhubdb --remote --env production -c ../../apps/api/wrangler.toml --file ./seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:staging: bun run src/seed.ts && wrangler d1 execute pymeshub-staging --remote --env staging -c ../../apps/api/wrangler.toml --file ./seed.sql
